title: Te Kaikaranga mai i te Hōhonu
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi wairua i tukua ki a ia tētahi karere atua, engari i roto i tētahi wā ohorere, ka wehe atu i tōna iwi me te kore whakaaetanga mārama. Nā tēnei haerenga rātou i ārahi ki tētahi whakamātautau whakaharahara, he whakamātautau hohonu o te manawanui me te whakawhirinaki ki te Runga Rawa. Ko wai tēnei tangata e ako ana i a tātou mō te ripeneta me te whānuitanga o te aroha noa o Allah?
clues: I tonoa ahau ki tētahi iwi nui, engari i pā mai te pouri ki ahau i tō rātou whakakorenga tuatahi.
I whakarērea e au tōku iwi, me te whakapono kua oti taku misioni, i mua i te whiwhinga o tētahi whakahau mārama kia haere.
I rapu huarahi ahau i runga i te kaipuke, engari nā te tupuhi nui me te tukinga rota i arahi ki tētahi āhuatanga kino.
I maka ahau ki te moana, ā, i horomia katoatia ahau e tetahi mea nui o te rire.
I roto i te pōuri o tōna puku, ka karanga ahau ki a Allah, me te whaki i aku mahi hē, me te rapu i tāna murunga hara.
I whakahau a Atua i te mea hanga kia maka ahau ki uta, ā, i ora anō ahau i raro i tētahi tipu ahurei.

trial.answer: Te horomia e te ika nui

options: I hoki mai ki te ārahi i tētahi iwi ripeneta
I tukuna te mana ki runga i ngā jinn
I ārahi i te iwi puta noa i te koraha
outcome.answer: I hoki mai ki te ārahi i tētahi iwi ripeneta

verse: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy. (37:142)
